format: JSON receipt; one complete run per file

producer.rule: subject and emission must identify observational limits; a reconstructed host trace is never compiled guest proof

semantics.seq: all events linearly ordered by observed linearization points, contiguous 0..N-1 (reconstructed evidence does not claim actual timing)
semantics.actor_id: opaque nonempty identifier; generation is a positive integer; restarts require prior actor_retire and strictly incremented generation
semantics.serial: serial actors allow at most one active receive; nonserial actors may have concurrent receiver methods, up to declared test budget
semantics.send_accept: successful mailbox admission is a linearization point; failed sends MUST NOT generate send_accept
semantics.control_admit: one outstanding supervisor CONTROL notice per generation; this path does not consume a DATA slot
semantics.control_dispatch: consumes pending CONTROL and fences new DATA dispatch; active receives must finish or be independently unwound before retirement
semantics.receive_start: must match admitted, not yet consumed message and cannot leapfrog a pending CONTROL notice
semantics.receive_complete: must match the exact active receiver and message; settle exactly once
semantics.message_discard: permitted only for queued, never running DATA during close/fence
semantics.critical_read_enter: any number of readers permitted, no writer; receiver must be active
semantics.critical_write_enter: exclusive; no other read/write holders; receiver must be active
semantics.critical_exit: paired with the exact receiver that acquired it; no locks may outlive receive completion
semantics.actor_close: closes future admissions; draining or discarding admitted work remains required
semantics.actor_retire: after close, no outstanding CONTROL, DATA, receiver frames, or critical locks; release arena only after physical quiescence is independently verified
semantics.complete: complete receipts must retire every spawned actor; no unsettled work; empty receipts are invalid unless a test explicitly expects empty
semantics.invariant_scope: bounded finite observed histories, not arbitrary unbounded executions or hard real-time/GC certification
